register.description: A statistics threshold separate from the CIR and PIR

bitfield.description: Read bandwidth stats threshold in bytes. Note that this is total bytes, unlike CIR and PIR. CIR and PIR are based on a rolling window, and the statistics threshold is based on a fixed window. This will still take into account DDR bytes used, so can be compared to CIR and PIR directly if the bandwidths are converted via the equations for CIR and PIR. The threshold bandwidth is programmed here as bytes per window Reset Source: rst_mod_g_rst_n

register.description: Read Bandwidth Statistics - Window Count

bitfield.description: Read bandwidth window count - the number of windows elapsed since statistics collection began Reset Source: rst_mod_g_rst_n

register.description: Read Bandwidth Statistics - CIR Count

bitfield.description: The total number of statistics windows in which Read Commit Information Rate occurred. Note that if PIR is set to a lower value than CIR or if the burst offset feature is used, this will also count times that PIR is reached. Reset Source: rst_mod_g_rst_n

register.description: Read Bandwidth Statistics - PIR Count

bitfield.description: The total number of statistics windows in which Read Peak Information Rate occurred Reset Source: rst_mod_g_rst_n

register.description: Read Bandwidth Statistics - Threshold Count

bitfield.description: The total number of statistics windows in which Read bytes transferred exceeded the statistics threshold Reset Source: rst_mod_g_rst_n

register.description: The maximum number of bytes seen in a single statitsics window. This can be compared with the window size to calculate the maximum bandwidth seen

bitfield.description: Max number of bytes in a single window. This number accounts for DDR bandwidth consumed, not simply the accumulation of the packet bytecnt values across a window. The max bandwidth calculation is the total bytes value in this MMR divided by the windows size in RD_BW_STATS.window and multiplied with the interface frequency: RD_BYTES_MAX * FREQ / RD_BW_STATS.window Reset Source: rst_mod_g_rst_n

register.description: The maximum number of outstanding read transactions the rate limiter will allow

bitfield.description: The maximum number of outstanding read transactions allowed. NOTE: This cannot be programmed to a zero. If a zero is written, it will default to the reset value of 16'd64, as a limit of zero outstanding transactions would hang the interface. Reset Source: rst_mod_g_rst_n
